responsibility: Provides the primary RTL machine description for TILE-Gx instruction selection and assembly output. It defines target UNSPEC codes, core instruction and expander patterns, attributes and output templates for arithmetic, memory, branch, network, stack-protector, and other target-specific operations, and includes sync.md so that RTL expansion and recognition can map GCC operations onto TILE-Gx instructions and special registers.
same_name_distinction: Holds the machine description used by GCC’s RTL matcher/generator—define_insn, define_expand, attributes, and UNSPEC-based instruction semantics—rather than the C hook implementation in tilegx.c, the target configuration macros in tilegx.h, or the option declarations in tilegx.opt.
